action.title: Move €500 to savings now
action.summary: A one-off transfer of €500.00 from this account to savings. Simulation only: no money moves.
checklist: Check the savings account the money goes to.
Approve, and the transfer is made at once.
Review the amount after three months.

impact.summary: €500 moved to savings. It is your own money in a different pot: it earns nothing here, but it is out of reach of everyday spending.
